name: web-terrarium-microcosm-site-with-vertical-title-and-mobile-hero
title: Glass terrarium photo with giant vertical white BIOLOARK and a mobile hero with a black CTA
whatItIs: A dark forest-green photo of a glass teardrop terrarium with carnivorous plants and a lamp cap, a huge rotated white 'BIOLOARK' along the left edge and a white-bordered phone showing the same photo with a small logo, a centred headline and a wide black 'В КАТАЛОГ' button.
whatItMeans: Immersive and quiet; a giant rotated word and the plant image feel like a nature documentary.
techniques: Rotate a giant white word up the edge.
Use a moody macro nature photo.
Show a phone with the same photo.
Add a wide black CTA at the bottom.

vocabulary.definition: The same image used on poster and screen.
